capabilities: fetch assigned GitHub issues and pull requests
append them to the note as checkbox tasks
configure task prefixes, suffixes, and created-date tags
avoid duplicating tasks already in the note
insert tasks at the cursor position
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull your assigned GitHub issues and pull requests into notes as task list items.

relations.evidence: Fetch currently assigned GitHub issues and pull requests.
Optional created date tag ([created:: YYYY-MM-DD]) for use with the Tasks plugin.

summary: Command-based plugin that fetches GitHub issues and pull requests assigned to you and appends them as checkbox tasks to the current note.
